items.cmd:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="describe me")
    ap.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    data = json.loads(args.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(f"{args.path}: {len(data)} keys")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

items.cmd:
import numpy as np
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import box

minx, miny, maxx, maxy = 88.0, 20.5, 92.7, 26.7   # rough Bangladesh bbox
step = 0.25
cells = [box(x, y, x + step, y + step)
         for x in np.arange(minx, maxx, step)
         for y in np.arange(miny, maxy, step)]
gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=cells, crs="EPSG:4326").to_file("grid.geojson", driver="GeoJSON")

# pip install cryptography
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey

sk = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
pk = sk.public_key()
sig = sk.sign(b"hello")
pk.verify(sig, b"hello")          # raises InvalidSignature if wrong
